Hi {{first_name}},

I am Conaugh, based right here in {{location}}. I saw you're with {{brokerage}} and wanted to reach out with something I think could give your listings a serious edge.

I create 3D virtual walkthroughs for real estate agents — the kind where buyers can literally walk through a property from their phone or laptop. Think Matterport, but no $3,000 camera and no monthly subscription.

In a market where every listing looks the same online, this is how you differentiate.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call this week? I'll have your free walkthrough done the same day we meet.
